scripts.backend:dev: uv run --project backend --frozen uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.frontend:check: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --project backend --frozen python scripts/export_openapi.py && node scripts/generate-api-types.mjs
scripts.contracts:check: uv run --project backend --frozen python scripts/export_openapi.py --check && node scripts/verify-contracts.mjs
